question.prompt: What is the starting URL for the web Todo application that this reload-persistence test should open?

options.label: Use {{start_url}}
options.detail: Keep the test authored with the {{start_url}} placeholder until the runnable environment supplies the actual address.

options.label: Provide URL
options.detail: Replace the placeholder with the concrete starting URL for the Todo application.

content.risk_rationale: A web test cannot run without a concrete starting URL, so this missing entry point blocks execution even though the persistence assertions are otherwise observable.
